title: Correctness: FIPS gate not first in ioctl_reset
description: In ioctl_reset() (crypto2dev_fd.c), the FIPS gate check (ops->fips_gate()) is at line 1474, after: (1) fd_type check (line 1463), (2) finalized/error check (line 1468). provider.h explicitly lists sess_reset in the set of callbacks that require FIPS gating: 'Called by the framework before every provider callback that touches cryptographic state (sess_init, set_iv, gen_iv, set_aad, set_tag, update, finalize, get_tag, sign, verify, agree, kdf, sess_reset...)'. Trigger: ioctl(fd, RESET) on a finalized session when the provider FIPS gate would return non-zero — the session state (finalized flag, error flag) is inspected and acted on before the gate fires. FIPS compliance failure: gate must be first, before any state inspection that controls whether crypto work proceeds.
